items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals positive open; KOSPI tumbles over 6%; Brent below $106
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Tuesday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a positive open for the Nifty50. Asian markets were trading sharply lower as technology shares fell

items.title: Sebi extends relaxation to revise fresh issue size till March 2027
items.description: IPO-bound companies can increase or decrease fresh issue sizes by up to 50 per cent without filing fresh draft offer documents, provided the main objective of the issue remains unchanged
